data: Which of these token lengths are found in the training questions?

The question asks which token lengths are found in the training questions. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the number of white space-separated tokens in training questions (title plus body) and answers (for answerable questions only). 

Looking at the left graph, we can see the distribution of token lengths for training questions. The x-axis represents the lengths in tokens, and the y-axis represents the counts. The bars show the frequency of different token lengths. 

By examining the graph, we can see that the token lengths range from approximately 0 to 200 tokens. The most frequent token lengths appear to be around 25, 50, and 75 tokens. There is also a significant presence of longer questions, with some reaching up to 200 tokens or more. 

Therefore, the token lengths found in the training questions include 0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175, and 200 tokens.
